name: podocalyxin like

function.text: PODXL is the approved symbol for podocalyxin like. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in cell migration; epithelial tube formation.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
